sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
With 4 Defense it is a good minor hero defender, but with only 1 Attack it can only KO enemy heroes like [[SAS-070|Solwing: Eye in the Sky]]. [[LGS-045|Enforcer: Persistent Pest]] is a good replacement as it has the same Attack and Defense but it has an Exhaust action as well. [[OAL-062|Suit: Ms. C. Hubbs, Venice Agent]] is also a good replacement, since it has 2 attack, 4 defence and a Exhaust action, also its an [[Suits/TCG|Suit card]], meaning that you can also use it with card powers like [[SAS-029|DeFoe: Organization Lieutenant]] among other powers. [[LGS-051|Suit: Mr. Koskin, Elite Agent]] is also a very good replacement, but you have to discard a card in order to use it.
